summary.text: Keith Boehm is a Republican state senator from District 33 in Mandan who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Signe Snortland.
He is a business owner, farmer and rancher.

paragraphs.text: Keith Boehm was born in Bismarck, North Dakota, and attended Mandan High School.
His career has included co-owning a Flying J Travel Center and working as a farmer and rancher.
His legislative biography says he is married with eight children and 17 grandchildren.
Boehm assumed office on December 1, 2022, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.

His 2025 assignments include vice chair of the Industry and Business Committee and membership on the Energy and Natural Resources Committee, and he is vice chair of the interim Protection and Victim Services Committee.
